---
mode: agent
description: Build a component from a Figma frame using the Figma MCP
---
Use the Figma MCP to read the selected frame's design context. Generate a
component following frontend.instructions.md: Server Component by default,
Tailwind only (map Figma variables to tokens), named export, explicit Props
interface, co-located test. The Figma API key is provided via .vscode/mcp.json.
